decisions.title: Decision 001: Mature Product Positioning
decisions.decision: Use mature-brand product positioning. Do not lead with Founder Batch, first production run, or early-device framing.
evidence: The product can ship in 14-21 days.
The user wants cold-traffic paid conversion, not community crowdfunding.
AI + faith + wearable creates enough trust burden already; early-stage language can increase perceived risk.
decisions.reversalCriteria: Revisit if cold traffic shows low trust despite strong click intent, or if fulfillment constraints force a preorder/deposit model.

decisions.title: Decision 002: Initial Price $149
decisions.decision: Set the first public hardware price at $149.
evidence: Product visuals support a premium black-and-gold faith wearable.
The product includes hardware plus a companion software experience.
$149 keeps the product below mainstream premium wearable pricing while staying meaningfully above app-only subscriptions.
decisions.reversalCriteria: Revisit if high-intent Search traffic reaches checkout but fails to convert because of price or shipping trust concerns.

decisions.title: Decision 003: SEMrush First For Research
decisions.decision: Use SEMrush API as the first data source for paid-search strategy research.
evidence: SEMrush is better suited to competitor paid-search, ad copy, paid keyword, and landing-page discovery.
Google Keyword Planner is better as a final validation source for search volume, bid ranges, and forecasts.
Ahrefs is useful for organic/SERP/content research, but less directly aligned with the first SEM strategy question.
decisions.reversalCriteria: Revisit if SEMrush data lacks paid-search coverage for relevant Christian, Scripture, prayer, anxiety, anger, and stress keyword clusters.
